title: 第9章 师父指点她呢第10章 师父在忙
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 这个天地异象太恐怖了！
直接衍生出了恐怖的威压之力，至强的杀伐之力如同要焚天煮海一般，磅礴的灵火意志向着方圆数十里扩散，如同排山倒海一般。
天地变色，苍穹震荡。
青玄峰四周的灵峰温度瞬间升高。
这股力量太强大了！
瞬间，整个大道宗都被惊动了。
青玄峰附近的几个灵峰，温度骤然升高，如同火海，诸多圣人出手，这才压制住了那恐怖的灵火。
无数长老和弟子无比震惊，皆是向着青玄峰望去。
这是发生了什么事情？
很快，宗主等人也被惊动了。
无数神念和神识向着青玄峰探查而来。
众多圣王、圣人不禁震惊了起来。
青玄峰上，引动了天地异象！
宗主等人的神念继续探查。
他们很快发现了姬扶摇布下的封印禁制。
虽然以他们的实力，可以轻易穿过封印禁制，但他们没有再继续了。
不过很显然，这是姬扶摇修炼功法有所感悟！
这种感悟太过逆天，直接引动了天地异象！
而此时，虚空之上的灵火之海愈演愈烈，仿若要炼化虚影，映照苍穹，而在无尽火海深处，璀璨神华涌动，磅礴气势滔天，逐渐呈现出一种“道”与“势”。
宗主等人的心中瞬间掀起了滔天巨浪！
这是何等修炼天赋？
要知道“道”与“势”，那可是踏入玄圣境之后，才能触摸到的东西！
甚至一些玄圣终其一生，也没有机缘领悟！
现在姬扶摇才什么境界？
宗主看向丹峰众多圣人，“你们的灵火造诣极深，有没有看出点什么？”
丹峰众多圣人一脸震骇之色，“扶摇年纪轻轻就触摸到了一丝‘道’与‘势’，此等天赋，已有大帝之姿！”
大帝之姿！
宗主等人无比激动。
未来的大道宗又多了一尊大帝强者！
若是姬扶摇踏入准帝，则可以一跃成为大道宗老祖级别的人物！
众人心潮澎湃，心中对姬扶摇越来越满意。
丹峰圣人突然说道，“从今天的天地异象来看，扶摇入宗考核的时候绝对藏拙了。我总算明白为什么姬扶摇要拜陆玄为师了，她的身上恐怕有一些秘密，怕被我们看到。”
缥缈峰圣人目光柔和，“哎……这孩子。我大道宗帝境强者众多，只不过大都在闭关或者沉睡。即使扶摇是大帝之姿，我们也不会去觊觎她身上的秘密。”
宗主解释道，“关于扶摇身上的秘密，老祖在入宗考核的时候，就已经探查过了，她没有什么问题。”
“何况现在她已经是我大道宗的弟子，已经发下了天道誓言，不会背叛我宗。”
众人点了点头，“不错！在我大道宗，不同势力，不同身份的弟子很多，若是一一计较，早就没有我大道宗数个纪元的基业了。”
宗主下令，“扶摇身上的秘密，你们万万不可主动去窥探！”
众人道，“遵命！”
沉寂一瞬。
丹峰圣人点了点头，“扶摇心思缜密，想找个静修之地可以理解。不过陆玄非要收扶摇为徒，这作何解释？”
众人沉默住了。
完全想不通。
content_en:
This vision of heaven and earth is so terrifying!
Directly derived from the terrifying coercive power, the most powerful killing power is like burning the sky and boiling the sea, and the majestic spiritual fire will spreads to a radius of dozens of miles, like overwhelming mountains and seas.
The color of the sky and the earth changes, and the sky shakes.
The temperature of the spiritual peaks around Qingxuan Peak rose instantly.
This force is so powerful!
In an instant, the entire Dao Dao Sect was alarmed.
The temperature of several spiritual peaks near Qingxuan Peak suddenly rose, like a sea of ​​fire. Many saints took action to suppress the terrifying spiritual fire.
Countless elders and disciples were extremely shocked and looked towards Qingxuan Peak.
What happened?
Soon, the sect leader and others were also alerted.
Countless spiritual thoughts and consciousness came towards Qingxuan Peak to explore.
Many holy kings and saints could not help but be shocked.
On Qingxuan Peak, a strange phenomenon occurred in the world!
The spiritual thoughts of the sect master and others continued to explore.
They soon discovered the seal and restriction placed by Ji Fuyao.
Although with their strength, they could easily pass through the seal restrictions, they did not continue.
But it was obvious that Ji Fuyao had some insights from practicing the technique!
This kind of realization is so unbelievable that it directly triggers strange phenomena in heaven and earth!
At this time, the sea of ​​spiritual fire above the void became more and more intense, as if to refine the shadow and reflect the sky. In the depths of the endless sea of ​​fire, the bright divine flowers surged with majestic momentum, gradually showing a kind of "Tao" and "momentum".
The sect leader and others' hearts instantly stirred up huge waves!
What kind of talent is this?
To know "Tao" and "Position", that is something that can only be touched after entering the Xuansheng Realm!
Even some profound sages never had the opportunity to understand it throughout their lives!
What state is Ji Fuyao in now?
The sect leader looked at the many saints at Dan Peak and said, "You have a very profound knowledge of spiritual fire. Did you see anything?"
Many saints in Danfeng looked horrified, "Fuyao has touched a trace of 'Tao' and 'Shi' at a young age. With such a talent, he already has the status of a great emperor!"
The posture of an emperor!
The sect leader and others were extremely excited.
The future Dao Dao Sect will have another powerful emperor!
If Ji Fuyao steps into the quasi-emperor position, he can become an ancestor of the Dao Dao Sect!
Everyone's hearts were surging, and they were becoming more and more satisfied with Ji Fuyao.
Sage Danfeng suddenly said, "Judging from today's vision of heaven and earth, Fuyao was definitely hiding his clumsiness when he entered the sect for the examination. I finally understand why Ji Fuyao wants to worship Lu Xuan as his teacher. I am afraid she has some secrets in her body that we are afraid of being seen."
Saint Piaomiao Peak's eyes were soft, "Hey... this child. There are many powerful people in the Emperor realm of our Dao Sect, but most of them are in retreat or sleeping. Even if Fuyao is the emperor, we will not covet the secrets in her body."
The sect leader explained, "As for Fuyao's secrets, my ancestor had already explored it during the examination for joining the sect. She has no problem."
"What's more, now she is a disciple of my Dao Sect, and has sworn an oath of heaven and will not betray our sect."
Everyone nodded, "That's right! In our Dao Sect, there are many disciples from different forces and different identities. If we were to count them one by one, we would have lost the foundation of our Dao Sect for several epochs."
The sect master ordered, "You must not take the initiative to pry into Fuyao's secrets!"
Everyone said, "Yes!"
There was silence for a moment.
Sage Danfeng nodded, "Fuyao is very thoughtful and it's understandable that he wants to find a place of retreat. But Lu Xuan insists on accepting Fuyao as his disciple. What's the explanation?"
Everyone fell silent.
I can't figure it out at all.
